findings.title: Billing uses Order service's database
findings.message: orders-db sits in Orders team with Order service, which uses it. Billing, outside Orders team, goes to it directly: a change to its tables now has to ship in both.

output.hint: To fix one, send its fix.ops to edit_diagram as they are (one undo step). Only the person can ignore a finding. fix.others are other ways to make the same change: if the person prefers one, send its ops instead.
